title: One Goal, Two Dialects
kicker: The release, in HAL Schema Forms and in HAL-FORMS
html:
One Goal, Two Dialects

Release a pull request to Dev once it can be merged and its build passes its smoke test.

the goal, whole

Walked once with Claude, kept as a script, and released with no model, in both of HEART's dialects: HAL Schema Forms, and HAL-FORMS.

HAL Schema Forms4 of 5 promoted, 0 model calls per release
HAL-FORMS4 of 5 promoted, 0 model calls per release
504 stoppedby its smoke test, in both, as it should be
say: Remember the release goal: release a pull request to Dev once it can be merged and its build passes its smoke test. Eight lines of plain words. We walked it once with Claude and kept it as a script, in HAL Schema Forms. Today the same goal again, but every party answers in HAL-FORMS, the on-ramp dialect, _templates only. Walked once more with Claude, kept by the generator alone, and released five times with no model. Same outcome. Let me show you how, and what HAL-FORMS doesn't carry.

deck:fragment.name: goal
deck:fragment.label: The goal, whole (release.goal.md)
deck:fragment.text:
Release a pull request to Dev once it can be merged and its build passes its smoke test.

- Open pull request {pull} of {owner}/{repo} `as pr`
- At {watcher}, ask to be told when {pr} offers scm:merge `as watch`
- Once {watch} is answered, at {pr}, merge it by squashing `as merged`
- At {jenkins}, build commit {merged.merge_commit_sha}, asking to be told how it goes `as build`
- Once {build} is answered, follow its in-reply-to link to the build `as built`
  - Run the smoke script it links as ci:smoke-test, on the deployment it links as ci:deployment, with book = {book}, author = {author}, renewable = {renewable}, problem = {problem}, comment = {comment} `as smoke`
- If {smoke.passed}, at {dev}, open environment {environment} and promote commit {merged.merge_commit_sha}, citing {smoke.passing} of {smoke.of} scenarios passed `as promotion`
  Otherwise, at {pr}, act scm:comment with body = "Not promoted to Dev: smoke scenarios {smoke.failed} failed."
